leads.name: KAZIMOUR ARCHITEKTI — Ing. arch. Jan Kazimour
leads.business_activity: Architectural design and planning, family residences, reconstruction, historic sites and church buildings. Exact registered Prague architecture practice/sole trader IČO and website matching in public business directory. Faculty profile documents architect's current practice and portfolio collaboration; does not prove current pipeline or project turnover.

editorial_review.business_case: The publicly indexed first-party Kazimour architecture homepage exhibits generic English service list content ('3D Modeling', 'Predesign', 'Programming'), latest dated news anchored around 2020, and an architect profile with a template-like '/team-view/mark-johnson/' slug. A premium Czech-first studio project portfolio with responsive image-led cases and maintainable CMS may better reflect the documented heritage, residential and institutional projects. This is a visible content/URL hygiene opportunity, not proof of a broken website, bad mobile performance, absent customer leads or buyer intent.
editorial_review.evidence_scope: Search-engine indexed first-party pages (crawled around mid-2026), public verified IČO/Prague operating listing, dated university faculty profile and independently published collaborator portfolio. Direct website HTTP fetch timed out in browsing and could not be independently reached via the analysis environment; live status/SSL/mobile/browser defects unverified.
next_checks: Revisit exact first-party site on desktop and phone to check accessibility, mobile layouts, image quality and functioning contact fields; live fetch currently inconclusive
Confirm whether architect and current Kripner collaboration maintain separate customer-facing brands and whether the studio wants its own improved portfolio
Ask if project publications and images are available/authorized for a modern proposal
Confirm marketing decision maker, budget, operational capacity, and preference for Czech/English public-content-only CMS
